generation.explanation: If you invest $1 at 100% annual interest, compounding once a year gives you $2. Compounding n times a year gives (1 + 1/n)^n dollars. As n grows — monthly, daily, every second — this value climbs toward a limit of about $2.71828…, which is the number e. Continuous compounding is the mathematical ideal of interest growing at every instant.
